 ## Exact Permutation Test
 
 ```{r}
library(exactRankTests)
set.seed(1234)
grades <- split(student_no_outliers$G3,
                tolower(as.character(student_no_outliers$activities)))

mean_yes <- mean(grades$yes, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_no <- mean(grades$no, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_diff <- mean_no - mean_yes

result <- perm.test(x = grades$no, y = grades$yes, paired = FALSE,
                    alternative = "two.sided", mu = 0, exact = TRUE,
                    conf.int = FALSE)

CI <- t.test(grades$no, grades$yes,
             var.equal = FALSE, conf.level = 0.95)$conf.int

c(mean_no = mean_no, mean_yes = mean_yes, no_minus_yes = mean_diff)
result
CI
 ```
